items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held electronically at 1:03 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Live Stream Link
notes: Mayor B. Vrbanovic noted that today’s meeting was being held electronically and streamed to YouTube as the City’s Council Chamber technology is being renovated.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Councillor P. Singh - Building Faster Fund - 2024 Project, FIN-2024-327
notes: Councillor P. Singh declared a pecuniary interest with the Bramm Street Remediation Project as outlined in Building Faster Fund - 2024 Project, report FIN-2024-327, as he owns property within the vicinity, and did not participate in any voting or discussion on this matter.

items.title: Councillor S. Davey - Building Faster Fund - 2024 Project, FIN-2024-327
notes: Councillor S. Davey declared a pecuniary interest with Building Faster Fund 2024 - Potential Land Acquisition (Land Acquisition - Section 239 (c)) on the in-camera meeting this date, as well as, the Land Acquisition matter as outlined in Building Faster Fund - 2024 Project, report FIN-2024-327, as he has an indirect conflict due to a relative, and did not participate in any voting or discussion on this matter.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting then recessed at 1:08 p.m. and reconvened at 1:28 p.m. chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present except Councillors B. Ioannidis, C. Michaud and D. Chapman.

items.title: Building Faster Fund - 2024 Project, FIN-2024-327
notes:
Council considered Financial Services Department report FIN-2024-327, entitled Building Faster Fund – 2024 Investment Plan, dated july 9, 2024, recommending approval of Building Faster Fund  an Investment Plan that would allocate $14M of Building Faster Funds to the following City projects: Bramm Yards Remediation $1M; Sandrock Creek – Meadowlane Park Stormwater Improvements $3M; and, Land Acquisition for Future Housing $10M. Jonathan Lautenbach was in attendance to respond to questions from Council.

Due to the previously declared conflicts, each project was voted on separately.

Bramm Yards Remediation $1M, was then voted on and was Carried.

Sandrock Creek – Meadowlane Park Stormwater Improvements $3M, was then voted on and was Carried.

Land Acquisition for Future Housing $10M, was then voted on and was Carried.

items.title: Dangerous Dog Designation Appeal - Cane/Kane, COR-2024-326
notes:
Council considered Corporate Services Department report COR-2024-326, entitled Dangerous Dog Designation Appeal - Cane/Kane, dated July 4, 2024, recommending approval of a recommendation arising from the Dangerous Dog Designation Appeal held earlier this date.

Councillor J. Deneault brought forward the motion, noting the Committee at the Dog Designation Appeal held earlier this date made a recommendation to substitute the dangerous dog designation with a prohibited designation.
